card.name: Punctuation inside citations and standards
card.fires_on: Punctuation or separators inside reference citations and standard names, such as the period after a PDQ treatment title, or the hyphen and comma in 'IEEE Std 1003.1-2001'.

modes.label: Citation punctuation
modes.description: A period or parenthesis inside a National Cancer Institute PDQ reference entry.
modes.example: 2010:chap 32. National Cancer Institute: PDQ Pancreatic neuroendocrine tumors (islet cell tumors) treatment<<.>> Bethesda, MD: National Cancer Institute.

modes.label: Standard identifiers
modes.description: A hyphen, digit or comma inside the IEEE Std 1003.1-2001 designation.

card.writes: It seems to promote name-like openings such as Press, Hamp and Signal, as in publisher or place names after a citation.
card.plain: It lights up on the punctuation inside reference list entries and standards numbers, where a publisher or edition detail comes next.
